text: Planning is done. This is the first video in the series where real infrastructure gets created: the Windows Server Failover Cluster itself, spanning SQLDBA01 and SQLDBA02.

The Failover-Clustering feature goes on both nodes, Test-Cluster validates the pair before anything is created -- not a courtesy step -- and the cluster itself is built with -NoStorage, since the Availability Group needs no shared disk.

New-Cluster stands up BrennanWSFC with a static management address. Set-ClusterQuorum then points the cloud witness at the brennansqlbackups storage account, in its own container, separate from the actual backup files.
Health gets proven, not assumed: QuorumType confirmed as CloudWitness, both nodes showing State Up, and SQLDBA02 deliberately taken offline to confirm the cluster stays quorate on SQLDBA01 alone.
BrennanWSFC is real, validated, and quorate. Next: building BrennanAG itself on top of this now-proven cluster.
